storyboard.claim: The phrase prior commitment makes people hesitate before pushing back.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman pauses, weighing the phrase prior commitment.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Picks up the phrase the book suggests, from the previous beat.
storyboard.addedInformation: weak: the hesitation is staged, not shown on the other side of the request.
storyboard.staging: Everyman pauses mid-thought, a worried face weighing the phrase.

storyboard.claim: The phrase diffuses the tension because the subtext changes.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The boss hesitates before pressing the request on everyman.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why the phrase works, following the phrase itself.
storyboard.addedInformation: The boss is staged as the one who backs off, showing the shift in subtext.
storyboard.staging: A brisk boss pauses, a worried hesitation beside everyman.

storyboard.claim: The excuse shifts blame from preference to an immovable object.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A boulder in the path, the immovable object the narration names.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows from the phrase making the subtext change.
storyboard.addedInformation: The literal boulder matches the narrator's immovable object.
storyboard.staging: Everyman stands by the boulder, thinking about the obligation.

storyboard.claim: Using the phrase may just be a lie.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A false public face, the mask, beside everyman doubting.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns the previous beat into a doubt.
storyboard.addedInformation: The mask reads pretending, matching the narrator's question.
storyboard.staging: Everyman doubts, a mask in view.

callout.text: Only if rest has no value

storyboard.claim: Calling it a lie only holds if rest has no value.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman weighing rest against the lie charge.
storyboard.onScreenText: Only if rest has no value
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the doubt from the previous beat.
storyboard.addedInformation: The condition is the claim: rest has value.
storyboard.staging: Everyman reconsiders, pondering the condition.

storyboard.claim: Rest is a valid commitment, the core shift of the book.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman calm and settled, the commitment to rest.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Resolves the doubt into the book's core shift.
storyboard.addedInformation: Genuine warmth, not a fake smile.
storyboard.staging: Everyman at ease, content with rest.

callout.text: A block of your own time

storyboard.claim: A quiet Saturday is time allocated to yourself.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A clock marking a block of time that belongs to everyman.
storyboard.onScreenText: A block of your own time
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Builds on rest being valid, now as time.
storyboard.addedInformation: Clock reads as time, matching the block of time.
storyboard.staging: Everyman calm beside the clock.

storyboard.claim: A quiet block counts and needs no itinerary.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman celebrating the validity of downtime.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Confirms the block of time from the previous beat.
storyboard.addedInformation: No itinerary is needed to count.
storyboard.staging: Everyman celebrates the validity of downtime.

storyboard.claim: A commitment to yourself binds as much as a dentist appointment.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman pointing at the calendar of commitments.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Extends the commitment to self to a comparison.
storyboard.addedInformation: The comparison makes the self commitment equal.
storyboard.staging: Everyman points to a commitment as equal to any other.

storyboard.claim: Freeze the account but hand over a polite decline, not a slammed window.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman holds a polite decline letter.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Uses the account metaphor from the previous beat.
storyboard.addedInformation: The letter is the polite decline, not a refusal shout.
storyboard.staging: Everyman holds a letter, a gentle decline in hand.

storyboard.claim: People mess up by overexplaining after a polite decline.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman worried, anticipating the mistake.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns to the pitfall of the strategy.
storyboard.addedInformation: Sets up the mistake that follows.
storyboard.staging: Everyman frets over the coming mistake.

storyboard.claim: After a soft decline we often feel lingering guilt.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman slumped with guilt after the decline.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Names the guilt the previous mistake grows from.
storyboard.addedInformation: The slump shows guilt, not anger.
storyboard.staging: Everyman slumps, weighed down by guilt.

storyboard.claim: To ease guilt we make the fatal mistake of offering excuses.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman talking, sad, offering excuses.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the mistake the guilt leads to.
storyboard.addedInformation: Strike marks the excuses as the rejected move.
storyboard.staging: Everyman talks, sad, offering the excuse.

storyboard.claim: Excuses are a loophole deeply ingrained in etiquette.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A door, a way out, beside everyman thinking.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Names the excuse as a loophole.
storyboard.addedInformation: The door reads an escape route, matching loophole.
storyboard.staging: Everyman pauses by the door, an exit through excuses.

storyboard.claim: The neighbor asks for help building his deck on Saturday.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The neighbor on the street with a half-built deck, talking to everyman.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Scene opens on the Saturday neighbor request.
storyboard.addedInformation: Scene setting on the street.
storyboard.staging: The friendly neighbor talks, asking for help with his deck.

callout.text: I'd love to, but not now

storyboard.claim: The soft decline opens with a polite I'd love to but.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman talking, sad, giving the soft decline to the neighbor.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Everyman uses the soft decline the neighbor asked for.
storyboard.addedInformation: The sad face shows the reluctance behind the polite phrase.
storyboard.staging: Everyman gives the soft decline, a reluctant talk.

callout.text: Take my kids to the movies

storyboard.claim: The excuse, taking kids to the movies, sounds perfect so far.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman happy and talking, the excuse on screen.
storyboard.onScreenText: Take my kids to the movies
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The excuse follows the soft decline.
storyboard.addedInformation: The happy face shows the false comfort of the excuse.
storyboard.staging: Everyman talks, happy, giving the movie excuse.

storyboard.claim: The neighbor's follow-up snaps the trap shut on the excuse.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The neighbor smirking and pointing at tomorrow, trapping everyman.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The neighbor counters the excuse from the previous beat.
storyboard.addedInformation: Smirk gives the neighbor an edge, showing the trap.
storyboard.staging: The neighbor smirks and points to tomorrow, catching everyman.

storyboard.claim: An excuse opens a negotiation you never wanted, painting you into a corner.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Chains around everyman, bound by the negotiation.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The trap from the previous beat now binds everyman.
storyboard.addedInformation: Chains read bound, matching being caught.
storyboard.staging: Everyman slumps, bound by chains.

callout.text: A blueprint to defeat your boundary

storyboard.claim: The excuse hands the requester a blueprint to defeat your boundary.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman holds notes, the blueprint.
storyboard.onScreenText: A blueprint to defeat your boundary
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the trap from the previous beat.
storyboard.addedInformation: The notes read as the plan the requester gets.
storyboard.staging: Everyman holds notes, worried, thinking over the blueprint.

storyboard.claim: Once you offer the first excuse, you are on the hook.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman slumped, on the hook.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the blueprint from the previous beat.
storyboard.addedInformation: No named person is shown: Zar Hardy is not in the story bible.
storyboard.staging: Everyman slumps, hooked by the first excuse.

storyboard.claim: A second excuse makes you look like you are lying.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A mask beside everyman, the false face of a lie.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The second excuse follows from being on the hook.
storyboard.addedInformation: The mask reads pretending, matching lying.
storyboard.staging: Everyman thinks sadly, a mask in view.

storyboard.claim: A simple polite categorical refusal stops the negotiation dead.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman confident, pointing firmly.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the alternative to excuses.
storyboard.addedInformation: Confident pose, the refusal is firm.
storyboard.staging: Everyman points, confident in the refusal.

storyboard.claim: The silence after an excuse-free refusal is heavy.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman in the silence, worried.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns to the silence after the refusal.
storyboard.addedInformation: Worry shows the discomfort of the silence.
storyboard.staging: Everyman thinks through the heavy silence.

storyboard.claim: Excuses are the social glue of our society.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman talking, sad, about the social glue.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why the silence is heavy.
storyboard.addedInformation: Sad talk states the social claim.
storyboard.staging: Everyman talks, sad, about social glue.

storyboard.claim: Staring in silence would look like a sociopath.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman staring blankly.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the excuse-free refusal fear.
storyboard.addedInformation: Blank face shows the stare, not a sociopath itself.
storyboard.staging: Everyman stares blankly, a cold reaction.

storyboard.claim: People hate silence and give reasons to show empathy.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman thinking through the silence.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why people give reasons.
storyboard.addedInformation: Worried thinking shows the discomfort.
storyboard.staging: Everyman thinks, uncomfortable with silence.

storyboard.claim: An excuse is a puzzle to the requester, not empathy.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman thinking about the puzzle.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Reframes the excuse from the previous beat.
storyboard.addedInformation: The reframing is the claim.
storyboard.staging: Everyman thinks about the reframe.

storyboard.claim: Humans are inherently problem solvers.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A lightbulb, the idea of problem solving.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why excuses become puzzles.
storyboard.addedInformation: Lightbulb reads an idea, matching problem solver.
storyboard.staging: Everyman idle beside a lightbulb.

storyboard.claim: An excuse becomes a problem the requester solves.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A flow from excuse to solve it.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the cause-effect of the puzzle.
storyboard.addedInformation: The flow is the structure of the claim.
storyboard.staging: Diagram carries the meaning.

storyboard.claim: Without a puzzle, the requester has no choice but to accept the boundary.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The friend offers to lend, pointing, while everyman waits.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The friend offers the solution the puzzle invites.
storyboard.addedInformation: The friend is the one offering the solution.
storyboard.staging: The friend offers help with a point, cheerful.

storyboard.claim: Pivot the silence into interest in the project.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman talking cheerfully about the project.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the pivot from silence.
storyboard.addedInformation: Happy talk shows the warm pivot.
storyboard.staging: Everyman talks, cheerful, pivoting the conversation.

storyboard.claim: Close the door on the request but keep the relationship window open.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A door closed on the request, the window open beside everyman.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the pivot into the relationship.
storyboard.addedInformation: Door reads exclusion, window reads openness.
storyboard.staging: Everyman points toward the open window.

storyboard.claim: Stop giving excuses that invite another way to withdraw.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Everyman holds a wallet, thinking.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Uses the account metaphor again.
storyboard.addedInformation: Wallet reads the account that only holds so much.
storyboard.staging: Everyman holds a wallet, thinking about the withdrawal.

storyboard.claim: Examine the grammar of boundary words, the actual words.

storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from excuses to the words themselves.
storyboard.addedInformation: The words are the claim, not an icon.
storyboard.staging: Everyman thinks about the words used.

storyboard.claim: Move from the language of restriction to the language of identity.

storyboard.addedInformation: The point marks the shift.
storyboard.staging: Everyman points, confident in the shift.

storyboard.addedInformation: Strike marks I can't as the rejected phrase.
storyboard.staging: Everyman talks sadly, rejecting the old phrase.

storyboard.staging: Everyman afraid beside the hourglass.
